channel.description: Recent content in Resorts on YumFam

item.title: Xiamen Haiyue Shanzhuang — 1 Night + Go-Karting + Kids' Park from ¥799 (≈$113)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + go-karting + kids’ park — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,488, about 54% of list) · Bookable through Oct 25, 2026, no weekday/weekend surcharge · ⏰ valid through Oct 25, 2026

A national Top-100 family resort sitting on Xiamen’s Golden Coast (思明区环岛南路3999号) — the property is separated from the beach only by the marathon track, and an underpass leads straight to Huangcuo beach for sand play. Inside: 1,000,000㎡ of gardens with 20,000+ trees and 400+ rare plant species, 19 pools (outdoor pools open May–Oct), an ~800㎡ Little Dolphin kids’ park (ball pit, trampolines, wave slide), and 622 rooms.

item.title: Xiamen Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort — 1 Night + Breakfast & Hot Springs for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, from ¥666 (≈$94)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast & hot springs for 2 adults + 2 kids — from ¥666 (≈$94) (was ¥1,988, about 34% of list) · Bookable Oct 1 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Autumn is hot-spring season, and Riyuegu (海沧区孚莲路1888-1889号) is one of the biggest in Xiamen — ranked among Fujian’s top 20 family resorts. The headline numbers: 100+ outdoor hot-spring pools plus a 24-hour natural-spring soak, with silicic-acid and chloride springs rich in metasilicic acid, strontium and fluoride. The park itself is Southeast Asian–style, tucked at the foot of Tianzhu Mountain.

item.title: Hangzhou Tianmu Dusit Thani — 50㎡ Garden-View Room + Private Hot-Spring Soak, ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + private hot-spring soak — from ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥1,999, 30% of list) · Bookable daily Oct–Dec 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

An autumn hot-spring escape in the bamboo forests of Tianmu Mountain, about 60 minutes from downtown Hangzhou. Dusit Thani’s Thai-hospitality property pairs a spacious 50㎡ garden-view twin room with balcony and daily breakfast for two with a 30-minute private outdoor wellness hot-spring soak — autumn in the mountains, steaming water, nobody queuing behind you.

item.title: Beijing Minmetals Narada (Xishan) — 6th Anniversary Family Package from ¥799 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$111) (was ¥1,688 — over 50% off) · Anniversary gift pack included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Beijing Minmetals Narada is celebrating its 6th anniversary with a family-loaded package: 1 night in a Junlan Xishan room with breakfast for two, plus a gift pack of 2 single-session Super Wings (超级飞侠) Land tickets, 2 kids’ buffet dinner tickets and an extra-bed coupon. (Note: this is the Xishan property, not the Fangshan Narada hot spring resort also on this site.)

item.title: Shanghai Luan Garden Hotel — 2 Nights from ¥548 (≈$76), Free Disney Shuttle
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights from ¥548 (≈$76) (was ¥699) · 1 night ¥279 (≈$39) · ¥20 off orders over ¥299, ¥50 off over ¥598 · ⏰ bookable all year through Dec 31, 2026

A smart base for a Shanghai Disney trip: Luan Garden Hotel runs a free shuttle to Shanghai Disney Resort, includes daily breakfast for two, and throws in free parking. The standout offer is the 2-night package — stack the platform’s ¥50-off coupon and it lands at ¥548 for two nights (after coupon).

item.title: Guangzhou DoubleTree Zengcheng — Seafood Dinner + Infinity Pool from ¥499 (≈$69)
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$69) for 1 night + breakfast + Huanlewan park ticket · + breakfast + seafood dinner ¥698 (≈$97) · Breakfast only, 2 nights ¥698 · + breakfast + brunch ¥499 · + breakfast + fruit picking + movie ticket ¥499 · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

At 61% off the ¥1,288 rack rate, the DoubleTree by Hilton Guangzhou Zengcheng (at Zengcheng Wanda Plaza) is the resort-style base camp for the district’s attractions. The dinner package comes with the hotel’s Southeast Asia-themed seafood dinner buffet, plus a 168 m² outdoor infinity pool that photographs beautifully at sunset, a 24-hour gym, and 232 rooms with Crabtree & Evelyn bath products, 55-inch TVs and smart toilets. Huanlewan amusement park is ~14 minutes by car; Baishuizhai and Junming Happy World are about half an hour away.

item.title: Guangzhou Emerald Hilton — Hot Spring & Twin-Pool Family Retreat from ¥799 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: ¥799 (≈$111) for 2 adults + 2 kids, 1 night with dinner + breakfast buffets · 2 nights with breakfast ¥899 (≈$125) · Dinner + breakfast, 1.2 m kids ×2 allowed ¥899 · Dinner + breakfast, 1.4 m + 1.2 m kids ¥999 (≈$139) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The Emerald Hilton in Guangzhou’s Huangpu Science City packs a whole resort day into one stay: forest hot-spring pools plus an outdoor sauna room, indoor and outdoor pools, an indoor kids’ playground, a sauna, and a themed dinner buffet with 8 kinds of seafood — Norwegian air-freighted salmon and tuna, unlimited thick-cut sashimi, flame-grilled salmon sushi and 10+ desserts. Book early: the first 8 rooms each day get a free upgrade to a deluxe room. Metro Line 21 Science City station is a 5-minute walk; Line 6 Xiangang is 10 minutes on foot.

item.title: Hangzhou Hilton Garden Inn Luniao — Forest Retreat with Rafting from ¥499 (≈$69)
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$69) for 1 night + breakfast for two + 2 tickets to Wangweishan adventure park · + Xianlongxia rafting instead ¥659 (≈$92) · + intangible-heritage bamboo-weaving kit ¥499 · Family room + breakfast for three + stream-play kit ¥499 · + camping BBQ for two ¥599 (≈$83) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Tucked into a vast forest in Luniao, Yuhang — next to the 4A-rated Jingshan scenic area — the Hilton Garden Inn Hangzhou Luniao is the rare mountain stay that works for kids: a free children’s game room, an indoor and outdoor kids’ playground, a 24-hour gym, and Peter Thomas Roth bath amenities. Pick your adventure: Xianlongxia rafting (15 sharp bends, 24 slides — billed as the Yangtze Delta’s most thrilling gorge rafting), tickets to the Wangweishan adventure park, a stream-play set for the family room, or an evening camping BBQ. No weekend surcharge, and holiday dates are bookable too.

item.title: Shanghai Four Points by Sheraton Qingpu — 2 Nights from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights for ¥699 (≈$97) · 1 night with breakfast + afternoon tea ¥399 (≈$55) · Family-themed room 1 night with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid ¥499 (≈$69) · Business suite 1 night ¥699 (≈$97) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

A newly opened Four Points by Sheraton in Shanghai’s Qingpu New Town is running a grand-opening promo: no weekend or holiday surcharge, and validity runs all the way to 28 February 2027. All 149 rooms come with the brand’s Comfort Bed, a 65-inch TV and a standalone shower. The 5th floor houses the all-day restaurant, lobby lounge and a beer bar.

item.title: Beijing Fangshan Narada Resort — Hot Spring Stay from ¥759
item.description:
Deal price: ¥759 (≈$105) for 1 night · 2 nights ¥1,399 (≈$193) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Narada Resort sits in Beijing’s Fangshan foothills, and the deal is built around the hot spring center: your package includes double tickets with unlimited entry during your stay, therapeutic function pools, and an outdoor spring that reviewers call the highlight on a cold day. The Lan Jing superior room is new, big and quiet — breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid is included.

item.title: Shanghai Snow World Crowne Plaza — 2-Day Snow Play Stay for ¥999
item.description:
Deal price: ¥999 (≈$138) for 1 night · was ¥1,699 · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

This is the official hotel of Shanghai Snow World (耀雪冰雪世界) in Pudong’s Lingang — China’s headline indoor ski/snow complex. The package packs a lot in: a superior room, next-morning breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid (kid = under 1.5m), and 2-day unlimited snow play tickets for the same trio — snow play all day, two days running. Free parking, gym access, and an attached mall for meals.

item.title: Beijing Shiyuan Hyatt — 1 Night + Breakfast + Pick-3 Activity Pass from ¥699
item.description:
Deal price: ¥699 (≈$96) for 1 night · 2 nights (or 2 rooms for 1 night) ¥1,388 (≈$191) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The Hyatt Regency Beijing Shiyuan sits in Yanqing’s Expo Park district — the green, mountain-fringed side of Beijing — and this package turns a hotel night into a full family day out. You get a Hyatt king or twin room, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (child under 12), and your pick of 3 from 6 activities (each listed for 2 adults + 1 child, single use):

item.title: Sanya Swissôtel Yalong Bay — 2 Nights + Breakfast & Dinner from ¥1,299
item.description:
Deal price: ¥1,299 (≈$179) for 2 nights · Family room 2 nights ¥1,599 (≈$221) · Suite 2 nights ¥2,399 (≈$331) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Swissôtel Yalong Bay brings Accor’s Swiss hospitality to Sanya’s best-known beach. The headline package: 2 nights in a Swiss-style family room, daily breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (kids under 1.4m), one buffet dinner for two, free rein in the 800㎡ kids club, the lagoon-style pool — and the beach is about a 5-minute walk away.

item.title: Beijing Junhe Howard Johnson — 1 Night + Unlimited 3,000㎡ Hot Spring Spa from ¥598
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥598 (≈$82) for 1 night · 2-night stays from ¥998 (≈$138) · Family rooms from ¥898 (≈$124) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Hot-spring season is on (Sep 1, 2026 – Mar 15, 2027) at the Beijing Junhe Howard Johnson, a full-service resort hotel on the banks of the Chaobai River in Shunyi — near the Hanshiqiao Wetlands and Beijing International Flower Port. The headline number: 3,000㎡ of indoor and outdoor hot-spring pools, unlimited entry during your stay. The base ¥598 package (about 40% off the ¥999 rack rate) bundles a 45㎡ deluxe room, buffet breakfast for two, two hot-spring tickets, two tickets to the Sacred Deer Forest theme park (deer, alpacas, family rides), an alpaca-feeding pack for the kids, plus free parking, Wi-Fi, and a football play area.

item.title: Sanya Tianliwan Grand Hyatt — 2 Nights + Daily Breakfast for 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥1,188
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥1,188 (≈$164) for 3 days / 2 nights · Up to sea-view Club room packages at ¥1,899 (≈$262) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

This is Hyatt’s 2023 flagship in Sanya — a “one bay, one hotel” property on a pristine cove in Sanya Bay with its own private beach, a rare rocky coastline, and a signature pink-sand beach that the kids’ photos will love. Rooms start at 50㎡ with balconies and bathtubs, and the resort runs a 2,800㎡ outdoor pool complex (adult, kids’ and whirlpool areas, 18m blue-whale slide, night light shows), an 800㎡ kids’ camp for ages 3–12, a game/entertainment center and 24-hour gym. It’s about 5 minutes from Tianya Haijiao and West Island, 7 km from the airport.

item.title: Atlantis Sanya — 2 Nights Sea-View Room + Waterpark & Aquarium for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, from ¥2,788
item.description:
Deal price: ¥2,788 for 2 nights (≈$388) (was ¥5,376 — 5.2折, 48% off) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Sanya’s Atlantis at an off-peak price: two nights in a sea-view room for the whole family (2 adults + 2 kids aged 11 and under) with unlimited access to Aquaventure Waterpark and The Lost Chambers Aquarium throughout your stay — the park tickets alone would cost more than this package. You’ll also catch three underwater shows (whale-shark dance, mermaid dance and fish storm) and a free dolphin meet-and-greet session. Reserve by 23:59 the day before; check-in 15:00, check-out 12:00; refundable before use.

item.title: Fragrant Hill Hotel Beijing — Autumn Stay Inside the Park, from ¥569
item.description:
Deal price: ¥569 (≈$79) (was ¥1,256 — 54% off) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Right in time for autumn foliage season: a night at the Fragrant Hill Hotel, set inside Fragrant Hill Park itself (40 Maimai Street, Haidian). The ¥569 tier covers a garden twin room with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child, free swimming during your stay, and free entry to the park for the duration of your visit — wake up early and climb the hill before the crowds. National Day dates are bookable with a surcharge; the package is refundable anytime before use. Deal ends Oct 11.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort — 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Park Entry
item.description:
Deal price: ¥999 (≈$139) (was ¥1,590 — 37% off) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Shanghai’s cruise-concept ocean theme resort, minutes from Haichang Ocean Park: one night in a superior room with breakfast for two, unlimited 2-day park entry for two adults, and a dedicated VIP entry lane so you skip the ticket queues. Valid at both the Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel and the Haichang Ultraman Theme Hotel (777 Qiqing Road, Pudong New Area). In select months, Friday check-ins carry zero surcharge — and the package is refundable anytime before use.

item.title: Wanda Realm Haitang Bay Sanya — 2 Nights from ¥999
item.description:
Deal price: ¥999 (≈$139) for 2 nights (was ¥1,599 — 37% off) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Two nights at Wanda Realm on Sanya’s Haitang Bay (18 Haitang North Road) for less than ¥500 a night: a garden-view room, daily buffet breakfast for two, a free minibar on your first day, daily family activities, and an open-air cinema in the mountain-sea garden every evening. The package is currently in a flash sale and refundable anytime before use; National Day dates are bookable with a surcharge.
